install.notes: Isaac Gym Preview 4 is a manual download from NVIDIA (README.md:22-24), and the package also needs torch and the bundled dexrobot_mujoco hand model (dexhand_base.py:17-21). The gate and the fake backend need none of this: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs, imports or runs the clone. The fake backend serves one kinematic environment; no sim backend is declared.
